seo_title: CERC Clears 400 MW Solar Tariff for WB, Tata Steel
title: CERC Adopts Rs 2.42-2.54/kWh Tariff for 400 MW Solar Supply to Tata Steel and West Bengal Discom
case_name: Solar Energy Corporation of India Ltd., In the matter of adoption of tariff for 50 MW and 350 MW ISTS-connected solar power plants set up by Azure Power India SPVs
citation: Petition No. 200/AT/2026 under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003, order dated 2 November 2026
card_summary: CERC adopted the tariffs discovered for two SECI-mediated solar packages routed through Azure Power India special purpose vehicles: 50 MW at Rs 2.54 per kWh for supply to Tata Steel, and 350 MW at Rs 2.42 per kWh for supply to the West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company. The Section 63 order lets the already-signed power purchase and power sale agreements for both packages proceed on these rates.
card_tip: A lender relying on a SECI-routed renewable PPA should check that CERC has adopted the tariff under Section 63 before treating it as bankable. The commercial contract alone does not fix the regulated rate.
verification_notes: Petition No. 200/AT/2026 matches the filename pattern CERC uses for its own record-of-proceedings documents on cercind.gov.in for this petition, though the order text itself was not independently opened. The capacities, buyers (Tata Steel for 50 MW, the West Bengal distribution company for 350 MW), per-unit tariffs (Rs 2.54 and Rs 2.42 per kWh), and the Azure Power India SPV structure are reported consistently across SolarQuarter, Construction World and P&W Solar. The 2 November 2026 order date is as reported by SolarQuarter and was not separately confirmed against the CERC order text.
